items.name: member-picker
items.title: Member picker
items.description: Pick a member of your org: a members-only GET /api/members route, backed by list_org_members, and a searchable list to choose from.
items.docs: Add the route to `api` in server/app.ts: import { orgMembersRoute } from "./org-members.ts", then "GET /api/members": orgMembersRoute(botpage). In the UI: const members = useOrgMembers() (from @/lib/org-members), then <MemberPicker members={members} value={userId} onChange={setUserId} />. Every org member who can open the app sees every member's name, email and role; drop email in src/lib/org-members-contract.ts if you don't need it. Members are identified by the Bot Page proxy, so the app must be reached only through it (the template listens on 127.0.0.1). The list is cached: someone removed from the org can still read it for up to 60 s, or about 6 minutes while the platform is unreachable.
